mechanism.claim: When daily aggressive-flow imbalance accelerates in the same direction across at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals and BTC during a high-variation completed UTC day, broad one-sided urgency is exhausted; fade the common acceleration for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict majority sign of six alt day-over-day taker-flow-imbalance changes
mechanism.why_distinct: CAFLR-6 follows hourly alt-flow disagreement with BTC and failed only structural novelty. CAFAER-12 instead fades daily cross-alt and BTC flow acceleration consensus; it does not filter, retime, or subset CAFLR clocks. AFGI fits a 52-feature learner. CAFAER uses no price direction, funding, OI, premium, residual, or learned model.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed-day realized-variation strict-prior rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 00:05 UTC acceleration-exhaustion clock is sparse and mechanism-distinct

features.day: exact bars_binance 1m paths [D-24h,D); all 1,440 timestamps for all seven symbols
features.flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) per symbol and day; denominator strictly positive
features.acceleration: current valid daily flow imbalance minus immediately preceding valid calendar-day imbalance; gaps make the current day ineligible
features.breadth: at least four of six alt acceleration signs equal one strict sign
features.confirmation: BTC acceleration sign strict nonzero and equal to the qualifying alt majority
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m log(close/open)) over completed day
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 prior valid days; minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: 00:00 UTC after all exact daily paths complete

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily cross-alt flow-acceleration exhaustion mechanism plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, confirmation, day, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
